words: A whale crashed into their boat in the middle of the ocean, and they had to eat fish eyes to survive. You see, this couple were sailing their boat in the Pacific when a sperm whale smashed into it. The ship started sinking fast, and they had five minutes to grab everything they needed to survive, life jackets, 20 days of rations, a compass, and an inflatable dinghy. You see, they were at Point Nemo, the farthest place from any land. And when their food and water ran out, they had to eat the eyeballs of fish. Because the fish themselves were so salty, eating them was not an option. Instead, they ate the eyeballs because of the waxy layer of skin that protects fish eyes from salt water. They said they ended up craving fish eyes like it was some kind of luxury. And in the end, they were spotted by a cargo ship 300 miles from where their ship went down.
